name: psibase
description: Psibase development tools for VS Code-compatible IDEs: package naming helpers, AI rules, and MCP build/test/chain tools

psibasePackage.inlayHints.enabled.description: Show inlay hints labeling psibase naming slots.

psibasePackage.semanticHighlighting.enab.markdownDescription:
Color psibase naming identifiers by entity type. Highlights naming strings in Cargo.toml, `#[psibase::service(name = ...)]` in `.rs`, and `package` lines in `.wit`.

**NOTE:** VS Code **Editor: Semantic Highlighting** (`editor.semanticHighlighting.enabled`) must also be enabled.

psibasePackage.statusBar.enabled.description: Show psibase package context in the status bar (right side).

psibasePackage.aiRules.contributors.noBa.description: Do not preserve or design for backward compatibility (pre-alpha).

psibasePackage.aiRules.contributors.noWr.description: Never run writable/action-oriented git commands; read-only git only.

psibasePackage.aiRules.contributors.pack.description: Prefer one shared type within a package backend; no parallel DTO mirrors.

psibasePackage.aiRules.devs.serviceActio.description: Service/plugin error style — assert/expect at actions; thiserror for typed errors.
